zh: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。

en: Divide this line into twenty equal parts.
zh: 把这条线分成二十个等分。

en: Everybody is equal before the law.
zh: 法律面前人人平等。

en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

en: I suggest we move to a safer location.
zh: 我建议我们去个更安全的地方。

en: This room's location is great.
zh: 这间房间朝向很好。

en: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.
zh: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。

en: Tom tried to control his emotions.
zh: 汤姆试着控制他的情绪。

en: You should learn to control your emotions.
zh: 你应该学会控制自己的情绪。

en: Do the emotions develop in parallel with the intellect ?
zh: 情感与智力同步发展吗？

en: She turned down my request.
zh: 她拒绝了我的要求。

en: His request is very reasonable.
zh: 他的要求很合理。

en: I'm very sorry, we can't accept your request.
zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。

en: The US government didn't invest money in the virtual reality technology.
zh: 美国政府没有投钱于虚拟现实技术。

en: The company has a virtual monopoly in this area of trade.
zh: 这家公司实质上已经垄断了这种贸易。

en: A virtual state of war exists between the two countries.
zh: 这两国间实际上处于战争状态。

en: We can use the principle of virtual power to establish consistent boundary conditions.
zh: 我们可以采用虚功率原理建立相容的边界条件.

en: Happy families are all alike; every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
zh: 幸福的家庭都是相似的，不幸的家庭却各有各的不幸。

en: Those two are exactly alike.
zh: 那两个是一模一样的。

en: She loved her children alike.
zh: 她的孩子她都一样爱。

en: The current era is the atomic era.
zh: 现在的时代是原子时代。

en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
zh: 晶体管的发明标志著一个新时代的开始。

en: We are in the era of atomic energy.
zh: 我们身在原子能时代。

en: I'm extremely embarrassed that it has taken so long to reply.
zh: 我过了这么久才回信，真的十分不好意思。

en: The performers danced whilst singing - they performed extremely well.
zh: 演员们一边唱，一边跳，表演得好极了。

en: It is extremely hot and humid in Bali in December.
zh: 12月份巴厘岛极其炎热和潮湿。

en: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.
zh: 她讲话非常俗气。

en: The information is very important to us.
zh: 这些信息对我们非常重要。

en: I guarantee that this information is correct.
zh: 我保证这些资料是无误的。

en: We want to get more information.
zh: 我们想要更多信息。

en: In addition to English, he can speak French.
zh: 除了英语，他还会说法语。

en: My boy can't do addition properly yet.
zh: 我的儿子还不懂加法。

en: We had to pay ten thousand yen in addition.
zh: 我们还得付多一万日元。

en: I'm tired of her complaints.
zh: 我厌倦了她的抱怨。

en: I'm tired of all his complaints.
zh: 我厌倦了他所有的抱怨。

en: I'm sick of listening to her complaints.
zh: 我听她的埋怨听得十分厌烦。

en: There is no cause for complaint.
zh: 没有理由抱怨。

en: The entire universe is made up of different kinds of matter.
zh: 整个宇宙是由各种物质构成的。

en: The entire Brazilian people are united by their love of football.
zh: 整个巴西民族由其对足球的热爱团结在一起。

en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

en: Tom began to sing "Happy Birthday" and the entire restaurant joined in.
zh: 汤姆开始唱“祝你生日快乐”，然后整个餐厅的人都加入了进来。

en: I am in entire agreement with you.
zh: 我完全同意你。

en: He had spent his entire life in China as a doctor .
zh: 他整个一生都在中国做医生。

en: Can I ask you a favour?
zh: 我可以请你帮个忙吗？

en: He owes me a favour.
zh: 他欠我一个人情。

en: I'll recommend him as chairman, whether you are in favour of it or not.
zh: 你赞成也好，不赞成也好，我也会推荐他当主席的。

en: He and a colleague who went to China later translated The New Testament into Chinese.
zh: 他跟一个去中国的同事后来把圣经中的新约翻译成中文。

en: He is called Huan, we are colleagues.
zh: 他叫胡安，我们是同事。

en: I know John – we're colleagues.
zh: 我认识胡安，我们是同事。

en: She is held in very high regard by her colleagues .
zh: 她很受同事们的敬重。

en: Are there any bike lanes in Algiers?
zh: 阿尔及尔有自行车道吗？

en: Leaves lay thick in the lane.
zh: 小路上铺满了落叶。

en: The city government wants to set up special cycle lanes. However, a lot of drivers oppose the idea.
zh: 市政府想建设专门的自行车道。但是，很多司机反对这个主意。

en: Dan and Linda eventually moved to London.
zh: 丹和琳达最后搬去了伦敦。

en: He will eventually ruin himself.
zh: 他会最终毁了自己的。

en: There has never been a nation that was not eventually destroyed.
zh: 从古到今，没有过不灭亡的国家。

en: The idea seems great in theory, but have you fully considered the potential risks?
zh: 这个想法理论上很棒，但你全面考虑过潜在风险了吗？

en: According to the theory of evolution, species gradually change over generations.
zh: 根据进化论，物种会随着世代更替逐渐变化。

en: The team are now putting their theory to the test.
zh: 该团队正在检验他们的理论。

en: We associate the name of Einstein with the theory of relativity.
zh: 一提到爱因斯坦，我们就会想起相对论。

en: Theory and practice should go hand in hand.
zh: 理论得联系实际。

en: Your theory does not square with the facts .
zh: 你的理论与事实不符。

en: It is difficult to understand his theory.
zh: 他的理论很难懂。

en: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
zh: 当你提出一个问题，你期望得到答案。

en: She can assess investments very accurately.
zh: 她能很准确地评估投资。

en: Tom doubled his investment in a year.
zh: 汤姆一年内增加了一倍的投资。

en: Algeria should become China's main investment hot spot in the Mediterranean region.
zh: 阿尔及利亚应该成为中国在地中海地区的主要投资热点。

en: He was detected in the very act of stealing.
zh: 他在行窃的时后被发现。

en: Instead, they detect sounds through their tongues and feel vibrations through sense organs in the skull.
zh: 相反，他们通过舌头来侦测声音，并通过头骨内的感觉器官来感受震动。

en: He acted as my guide.
zh: 他担任我的向导。

en: I'm a tour guide in Tokyo.
zh: 我在东京做导游。

en: I'll act as a guide for you.
zh: 我为你充当导游。

en: A committee was constituted to investigate prices.
zh: 为了调查物价，成立了一个委员会。

en: These things constitute a balanced meal.
zh: 这些东西构成了一顿营养均衡的饭。

en: Ziri went to his fridge to grab some milk.
zh: 齐里走到冰箱前去拿牛奶。

en: Grab hold of the rope.
zh: 抓住绳子。

en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?
zh: 有谁想一起去吃饭吗？

en: Due to lack of funds, the program has not yet been implemented.
zh: 由于缺乏资金,这个计划尚未执行。

en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
zh: 公司从下个月开始推行新的管理制度。

en: Her designs will be put on ice until money is available to implement them.
zh: 她的设计将暂时搁起来，等有了钱再去实施。

en: Don't limit yourself because something looks too difficult to implement.
zh: 不要因为有些事情看起来很难执行而限制自己。

en: Books occupy most of his room.
zh: 书堆满了他的房间。

en: I think the job's very occupying.
zh: 我觉得工作很忙

en: Our original plan was to go to Spain, but it was too expensive.
zh: 我们的原始计划是去西班牙,但是去那里太贵了。

en: The original purpose of the Silk Road was not for trade.
zh: 丝绸之路形成的初衷并非是贸易。

en: This is a book full of profound, original, and challenging insights.
zh: 这是一本充满高深、新颖且富有挑战性见解的书。

en: This is the original painting, and the others are copies.
zh: 这画是原作,其他的是复制品。

en: We lead a very ordinary life.
zh: 我们过着十分平凡的生活。

en: Koko is not an ordinary gorilla.
zh: 可可不是一只普通的猩猩。

en: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.
zh: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。

en: She voted for Mr Nishioka irrespective of party lines.
zh: 她不论党派把票投给了西冈先生。

en: No one voted against it.
zh: 没有人投反对票。

en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
zh: 奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。

en: They would capture as many people as possible.
zh: 他们会尽可能地抓更多的人。

en: The policeman captured the man who was running.
zh: 警察抓了正在跑的那个男人。

en: The hunters captured the wild animal with a strong rope net.
zh: 猎人们用坚韧的绳网把野生动物捉住了。

en: She began to consider what use could be made of it.
zh: 她开始考虑怎样对它加以利用。

en: She considered it important that everything should be finished by eight.
zh: 她认为在8点以前把所有的事情完成很重要。

en: This watch runs well if you consider how old it is.
zh: 考虑到这只表已经用了这么多年,可以说它走得很好了。

en: Social workers must always consider the best interests of their clients.
zh: 社会工作者必须时刻考虑其当事人的最佳利益。

en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.
zh: 这被认为是一件大事。

en: I 'm trying to do what is best , but equally I 've got to consider the cost .
zh: 我想尽力做得最好，但同时我也得考虑费用。

en: I consider that he is a fool.
zh: 我认为他是傻瓜。

en: They did not consider whether they could afford the time or not.
zh: 他们没有考虑是否抽得出时间。

en: I'd like a single with a shower, please.
zh: 我要一间有淋浴的单人间。

en: A single room with bath, please.
zh: 我要一个带浴室的单人房。

en: Compared to a computer, a word processor has a single purpose.
zh: 文字处理软件和电脑不同的是，它只有一个用途。

en: He remained single all his life.
zh: 他独身一生。

en: The odds are 5 to 1 that she will win.
zh: 她获胜的机会是五比一。

en: Do you know the odds of winning the lottery once?
zh: 你知道赢得一次彩票的几率多大吗？

en: I know people think I'm odd.
zh: 我知道人们认为我古怪。

en: One, three, and five are odd numbers.
zh: １、３、５都是奇数。

en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

en: We study according to the schedule.
zh: 我们按照预定计划研读。

en: Please let me know the schedule beforehand.
zh: 请你事先把计划告诉我。

en: Fire has caused severe damage to the contents of the building.
zh: 大火导致那栋大楼里的东西严重损毁。

en: A severe storm turned the small village down to ground.
zh: 一场剧烈的风暴把小村夷为平地。

en: The improper use of medicine could lead to severe adverse reactions.
zh: 用药不当会引起严重的不良反应。

en: No one knows when a severe earthquake will strike Tokyo.
zh: 没有人知道东京甚么时候会发生大地震。

en: There was something a little severe and forbidding about her face .
zh: 她的脸色严厉且令人生畏。

en: Great care must be taken in the use of the balance.
zh: 这种天平使用时必须十分当心。

en: A credit balance of $ 50 was brought forward from his September account.
zh: 50 元的贷方余额是从他九月份的账上转来的。

en: I'd like to take the balance of my holidays in September.
zh: 我想在九月份用完我剩下的假期。

en: Could you verify the current balance in my account for me?
zh: 您能帮我确认一下我账户里的当前余额吗？

en: He lost his balance and fell to the ground .
zh: 他失去平衡摔倒在地上。

en: He strives to balance the past with the present .
zh: 他努力平衡过去与现在。

en: I think there's a balance to be had.
zh: 我认为要保持平衡。

en: When you learn to ride a bicycle you must learn to balance.
zh: 你学骑自行车时必须学会平衡。

en: He works for an advertising agency.
zh: 他为一家广告公司工作。

en: Where's the nearest travel agency?
zh: 最近的旅行社在哪里？

en: I work in a travel agency.
zh: 我在旅行社工作.

en: The court adjudged that the will was valid.
zh: 法院判决了那个遗言是有效的。

en: The court declared the defendant innocent.
zh: 法庭宣判被告无罪。

en: Anything you say can be used against you in court.
zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

en: The court required that he should pay the fine.
zh: 法院规定他交付罚款。

en: "What's that noise?" "It's a deer barking." "In the middle of the town centre?"
zh: 「那是什么声音？」「是只鹿在叫。」「在市中心？」

en: Employees of the call centre answer all customer service calls.
zh: 呼叫中心的员工负责接听所有客服电话。

en: She rented a flat close the to the city centre.
zh: 她在离市中心不远处租了间公寓。

en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
zh: 我想特别强调这一点。

en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

en: The program includes a 10- session course, with each session lasting three hours.
zh: 该课程包含10次授课，每次授课时长为三小时。

en: One day the boy joined a session in the room next to mine.
zh: 有一天，那个男孩参加了一个会议，就在我隔壁房间。

en: I think we've learned a lot about one another in this session.
zh: 我认为这段时间我们相互有了很多了解。

en: The school board will hold a session for the meeting.
zh: 学校董事会将为这次会议举行一次集会。

en: Hunger is the best sauce.
zh: 饥饿是最好的调味品。

en: Thousands of people died of hunger.
zh: 数千人死于饥饿。

en: The judge sentenced him to one year's imprisonment.
zh: 法官判了他一年有期徒刑。

en: Judging from the look on his face, it seems that he has succeeded.
zh: 从他脸上的神情来看，他似乎是成功了。

en: I will play Sudoku then instead of continuing to bother you.
zh: 那我就不继续打扰你，玩数独游戏去了。

en: Don't bother your parents with such a pointless thing.
zh: 别为了这样的小事麻烦你父母。

en: The others can't be bothered.
zh: 其他人不可以被打扰。

en: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.
zh: 我为你的卑鄙行径感到羞耻。

en: Forgiving others is a kind deed to yourself.
zh: 原谅别人就是善待自己。

en: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
zh: 球迷们安静下来，绷紧神经，观看两支球队的点球大战。

en: Is the incurrence of this penalty correct?
zh: 这个点球的判罚正确吗？

en: We should abolish the death penalty.
zh: 我们应该废除死刑。

en: His composition leaves nothing to be desired.
zh: 他的文章写得完美无瑕。

en: She is the woman of my desires.
zh: 她是我所渴望的女人。

en: There are no people who don't desire peace.
zh: 没人不渴望和平。

en: The market situation is difficult to evaluate .
zh: 市场形势难以评估。

en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
zh: 当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

en: The initiative measurably improved quality of life for the villagers.
zh: 计划使村民的生活改善了不少。

en: He takes the initiative in helping his mother do the housework.
zh: 他主动帮他妈妈做家务。

en: Marriage is the main cause of all divorces.
zh: 结婚是所有离婚的主要原因。

en: He divorced his wife last month.
zh: 上个月他和妻子离婚了。

en: I think she will divorce him.
zh: 我想她会和他离婚。

en: She intends to get a divorce.
zh: 她打算离婚。

en: Why is it important to know about a company’s culture?
zh: 了解一家公司的文化为什么是重要的？

en: Paris is a good city for people who are interested in culture.
zh: 对于修养心性有兴趣的人来说,巴黎是个好城市。

en: We are all to a great extent the products of our culture.
zh: 我们在很大程度上都是本土文化的产物。

en: When the government came to power, he was named minister of culture.
zh: 这届政府上台时，他被任命为了文化部长。

en: Cultures of the East and the West meet together in this country.
zh: 东西方文化在这个国家融合。

en: There is just not enough fun and frivolity in culture today .
zh: 当今文化中太缺少乐趣和轻松。

en: Because it's a developing country, some aspects of China aren't as good as those in Western countries.
zh: 因为中国是个发展中的国家，所以有的方面没有西方国家那么好。

en: He stressed the convenient aspects of city life.
zh: 他强调都市生活的便利方面。

en: However, other aspects have already surpassed the standards of many Western countries.
zh: 不过，其它的方面已经超过了很多西方国家的程度。

en: Are there any aspects of Shanghai that are not as good as those of Beijing?
zh: 上海有什么不如北京的方面吗？

en: Do you think that you are qualified for that aspect of the work?
zh: 你认为可以胜任那些方面的工作？
refs: 你认为你能胜任那方面的工作吗？

en: My friend is currently designing a user interface for the new operating system.
zh: 我的朋友正在为新的操作系统设计一个用户界面。

en: Would you like to become a trusted user?
zh: 你要不要成为可信赖用户？

en: Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.
zh: 科学发明并不总是使世界变得更美好。

en: From a strictly scientific point of view, history cannot be called a science.
zh: 从严格的科学观点来看，历史不能算是一门科学。

en: His methods are not scientific.
zh: 他的方法不科学。

en: He gave his life for the nation.
zh: 他把他的生命给了国家。

en: The President spoke to the nation on TV.
zh: 总统在电视上对国民讲话。

en: Every nation should help each other.
zh: 每个国家都应该彼此帮助。

en: I don't think that it is possible to generalise about a whole nation and say how all Japanese people are.
zh: 我觉得不可以泛化一个民族，说日本人怎么样。

en: Recession is a temporary falling off of business activity during a period when such activity is generally increasing.
zh: 经济萧条是一段时间内，当这样的经济活动普遍增长而造成的一种临时性的经济活动衰退。

en: Shizuko composed a poem about the change of the seasons.
zh: 志津子写了一首关于季节变化的诗。

en: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
zh: 委员会是由三男七女组成的。

en: The surprise rendered her speechless.
zh: 她惊讶得说不出话来。

en: Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.
zh: 虽然激情可能会褪去，却不容它破坏我们感情上的联系。

en: The rope broke under the strain.
zh: 绳子被拉断了。

en: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
zh: 汤姆最近压力特别大。

en: The elevators in a skyscraper are vital systems.
zh: 摩天大厦里的电梯是至关重要的。

en: The support of family and friends is vital .
zh: 亲友的支持极为重要。

en: I can't help admiring his talent.
zh: 我不禁欣赏他的才华。

en: In China, talented people are often described as "ten thousand mile horses".
zh: 在中国，人们常把有能力的人喻为“千里马”。

en: I feel admiration for his talent.
zh: 我很钦佩他的才干。

en: He makes good use of his talents.
zh: 他善用他的天赋。

en: A passport is usually necessary when you travel overseas.
zh: 海外旅行通常都要用到护照。

en: I'd like to make an overseas call.
zh: 我想打个国际电话。

en: I was overseas at the time.
zh: 我当时在国外。

en: There are thousands of participants at today's event.
zh: 有成千的人来参加今天的集会。

en: All participants must be registered.
zh: 所有的参加者都得注册。

en: The participants were for the most part women.
zh: 参与者大部分是女性。

en: The reporter criticized the politician.
zh: 记者批评了政治家。

en: England’s goalkeeper was criticized for the amount of goals he conceded.
zh: 英格兰的守门员因为自己失球过多而被批评。

en: Tom criticized Mary in front of everyone.
zh: 汤姆在所有人面前批评了玛丽。

en: When will it suit you to start?
zh: 甚么时候出发最方便你？

zh: 结婚虽然是很美好的事,但是不要著急,该是你的就是你的。

zh: 我们看到了远方灯塔的微光。

en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
zh: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。

en: Tom is an electrical engineer.
zh: 汤姆是一个电子工程师。

en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
zh: 鲨鱼对电子信号和噪音很敏感。

en: I left your flash drive at home.
zh: 我把你的优盘忘在家里了。

en: The flash wasn't working, so he couldn't take a picture in the dark.
zh: 因为闪光灯坏了，他不能在黑暗中拍照。

en: Straight golden hair slides over her shoulder.
zh: 垂直的金发滑过她的肩膀。

en: Speech is silver, silence is golden.
zh: 开口是银，沉默是金。

en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.
zh: 雄辩如银，沉默如金。

en: The lost fishing boat made a safe return to harbour.
zh: 迷路的渔船安全地返回了港口。

en: Having forgotten his key, he was able to open the door by inserting a wire in the keyhole.
zh: 他没带钥匙，用铁丝拨动了两下，门居然开了。

en: Latin was the language of religion and culture.
zh: 拉丁文是宗教与文化的语言。

en: I will continue to study Latin, because it is really interesting.
zh: 我要坚持学习拉丁语，因为它非常有趣。

en: We all knelt down to pray.
zh: 我们都跪了下来祈祷。

en: We are all praying for Japan.
zh: 我们全体为日本祈祷。

en: They knelt down and prayed that the war would end soon.
zh: 他们跪了下来祈祷，希望战争快点结束。

en: "You don't have to queue for my car," he offers.
zh: “我的车不需要排队阿，”他提议。

en: The queue for buying tickets was unbelievably long.
zh: 买票的人龙竟然那么长！

en: "But I'm already queuing," I tell him.
zh: “我已经在排队呢，”我告诉他。

en: You have to wait in the queue.
zh: 您必须排队。

en: You have to get in the queue.
zh: 您必须排队。

en: At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
zh: 我想这工作粗略估计得花上两个星期的时间。

en: Boxing is not always a rough sport.
zh: 拳击并不总是一种粗暴的运动。

en: Sometimes I walk to work, and sometimes I ride my bike, because I live very close to work.
zh: 我有时候走路去上班，有时候骑自行车去上班，因为我家离单位很近。

en: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.
zh: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。

en: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.
zh: 我们闲时应该出外晒晒太阳。

en: This soccer match is full of energetic and splendid competition.
zh: 这场足球赛充满着激情和精彩的竞争。

en: Is it splendid, this world?
zh: 这个世界是灿烂的吗？

en: I never saw such a splendid sunset.
zh: 我从没见过那么壮丽的日落景色。

en: He looks like a sportsman, but he is a writer.
zh: 他看起来像个运动员，但是其实是个作家。

en: Translation is by no means easy.
zh: 翻译绝对不是一件易事。

en: You can search sentences containing a certain word and get translations for these sentences.
zh: 你们可以搜索含有某个词的句子并得到这些句子的翻译。

en: I don't remember my grandmother's face accurately.
zh: 我记不清奶奶的脸。

en: Portugal was once an agricultural country.
zh: 葡萄牙曾经是一个农业国。

en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
zh: 边境上有一片农业区。

en: Using this device it's possible to turn ocean water into freshwater.
zh: 通过这个装置有可能把海水变成淡水。

en: I believe this fish is a freshwater fish.
zh: 我相信这条鱼是淡水鱼。

en: I honestly don't think Tom and Mary care.
zh: 我真的认为汤姆和玛丽不在乎。

en: It is a matter of principle with him to answer your questions honestly.
zh: 诚实地回答你的问题对他来说是个原则问题。

en: Honestly, I also want to learn Japanese.
zh: 其实我也想学日语。

en: It may be risky but we will chance it anyhow.
zh: 这可能有危险，但我们无论如何要冒一冒险。

en: He is well aware how risky this investment is.
zh: 他心里对这项投资的风险十分清楚。

en: I don't want to do anything risky.
zh: 我不想做任何冒险的事。
